title: MCP Java SDK browser DNS rebinding
root_cause: The Java SDK HTTP MCP server did not validate Origin before version 1.0.0, allowing a browser DNS-rebinding route to a local or private server when the serving framework did not add equivalent protection.
trust_boundary: attacker-controlled browser origin to local or private MCP tool authority
fix_summary: Maintainer advisory lists 1.0.0 as patched and Host/Origin validation at a proxy as a mitigation; patch code was not reviewed here.

title: process-compose MCP SSE browser DNS rebinding
bug_class: MCP local listener authentication and origin validation
root_cause: The MCP SSE listener accepted browser-origin requests without Host, Origin, or caller-secret checks; token middleware on the separate REST router did not protect MCP dispatch.
trust_boundary: attacker-controlled browser origin to local process-control MCP tools
fix_summary: Maintainer advisory identifies 1.120.0 as patched and suggests listener-side Host/Origin and caller-secret checks; the patch implementation was not reviewed here.

title: CircleCI MCP server browser DNS rebinding with PAT authority
root_cause: The remote HTTP /mcp routes lacked Host and Origin validation, so a browser DNS-rebinding request could reach local MCP tools under the server-held PAT.
trust_boundary: attacker-controlled browser origin to local MCP tools authorized by a CircleCI PAT
fix_summary: The merged fix validates Host and Origin on /mcp routes, allows loopback by default, and adds configured host/origin allowlists; public deployments must configure their hostname.
